name: Prettier
one_liner: Opinionated formatter that ended formatting arguments by removing the options.
what_it_is: A code formatter that reprints source from its AST according to fixed rules, deliberately exposing very few configuration options.
why_it_matters: Prettier's contribution was social rather than technical: by refusing to be configurable it removed formatting from code review entirely. That norm is now so established that the debate has moved on to whether it needs to be a separate dependency at all, which is the consolidation case Biome makes.
suitable_for: Any team that has ever argued about formatting in review
Projects where ESLint handles correctness and formatting is delegated
not_suitable_for: Codebases with strong formatting requirements it cannot express
Teams looking to reduce total dependency count — a combined toolchain may suit better
